interventions.title: High-Visibility Pillar Markings
interventions.description: Add reflective hazard markings to the structural pillars to improve driver awareness of the roadway edge.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening or Barrier
interventions.description: If space permits, widen the sidewalk or install a physical barrier/bollards to protect pedestrians from vehicle encroachment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen the narrow sidewalk on the right to improve accessibility and safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Barrier
interventions.description: Install a physical railing or crash-rated barrier between the narrow walkway and the travel lanes to protect pedestrians.

interventions.title: Lighting Upgrade
interventions.description: Install high-output LED lighting to improve visibility and safety within the enclosed underpass.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening/Curb Extension
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk around the bridge columns to maintain a consistent clear path width.

interventions.title: Protective Bollards
interventions.description: Install bollards along the curb to provide a physical sense of protection from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Remove the large pipe and all debris to restore a clear, continuous walking path.

interventions.title: Underpass Lighting Improvements
interventions.description: Install high-intensity, pedestrian-scale LED lighting throughout the underpass to improve visibility and security.

interventions.title: Vertical Separation
interventions.description: Install bollards or a raised buffer between the sidewalk and the travel lane to protect pedestrians from vehicle encroachment.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a formal crossing point.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Improvement
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole or widen the sidewalk to ensure a clear, unobstructed pedestrian through-zone.
